Company Profile

Company Overview

Fresca Premier fresh is a Kenyan fresh produce export company committed to supplying premium-quality vegetables to international markets. We specialize in the production, sourcing, packing, and export of fresh vegetables that meet the highest international standards for quality, food safety, and traceability.


Our mission is to build long-term partnerships by consistently delivering fresh, safe, and high-quality produce while supporting sustainable agriculture and responsible farming practices.

Quality & Food Safety

Food safety and quality are at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with growers and packhouses that comply with internationally recognized standards and continuously strive to meet customer requirements regarding food safety, sustainability, and ethical sourcing

Our Vision

To become a trusted supplier of premium Kenyan fresh vegetables to international markets by delivering quality, consistency, and exceptional customer service

Our Mission

To provide fresh, safe, and high-quality vegetables while building long-term partnerships based on trust, integrity, and reliability.

Our Products

We specialize in:

French Beans (Extra Fine and Fine)

Snow Peas (Mangetout)

Sugar Snap Peas

Why Choose Fresca Premier Fresh?

Our products are carefully selected, graded, packed, and prepared to meet the specifications of wholesale importers, retailers, and food service companies across Europe and other international markets.

Premium quality fresh vegetables Reliable sourcing and supply Strict quality control procedures Full product traceability Compliance with international food safety requirements Flexible packing according according to customer specifications Commitment to timely deliveries Customer-focused service

Brenda Ogollah is the Owner and Director of Premier Veg, bringing over 17 years of extensive experience in the fresh produce industry across both Kenya and the Netherlands.

She has worked with leading international companies, including Green Food Benelux Group and Fruit Advisor Group, where she served as an Account Manager in the Netherlands. Through these roles, she gained in-depth expertise in global fresh produce markets, quality standards, and international client management.

Brenda is currently actively engaged with well-established companies in Kenya, with a key focus on promoting and supporting fast-growing Kenyan exporters of fresh fruits and vegetables. Her passion lies in connecting Kenyan producers to international markets while ensuring reliability, quality, and long-term partnerships.

Her core principle and driving force is a strong commitment to exceptional customer service, ensuring that every client is professionally supported and well served.

‘expert in global fresh produce markets’

Andrea Ogada serves as the Administrator at Premier Veg Mondo, supporting the day-to-day operations and ensuring smooth internal and external communication.

She plays a key role in coordinating administrative processes, documentation, and client support, helping to maintain efficiency and organization across the company’s operations.

Andrea is committed to supporting the company’s growth by ensuring strong administrative systems, professional client interactions, and reliable operational support that contributes to Premier Veg’s overall success.

‘core efficiency’

Fredrick Harrison Kabuu is an experienced Agronomist and Compliance Auditor, providing professional compliance and agronomy support to Premier Veg and its partner farms.

With a strong background in agronomy and farm compliance, Fredrick plays a key role in ensuring that all farm and packhouse operations meet international certification and export requirements. His work focuses on maintaining and implementing critical documentation and standards, including GLOBALG.A.P and SMETA, to ensure full traceability, food safety, and ethical compliance.

In addition to auditing and documentation, Fredrick is actively involved in training farm and packhouse workers. This includes capacity building at both farm-level and packhouse-level operations to ensure best agricultural practices, quality control, worker welfare, and compliance with international market standards.
Through Farmbase Consulting Limited, Fredrick supports Premier Veg’s commitment to quality, transparency, and continuous improvement across its grower network.

‘traceability, food safety, and ethical compliance’

Allan Omondi serves as the Compliance Officer at Premier Veg Mondo Ltd, where he is responsible for ensuring that all fresh produce meets the required quality, safety, and regulatory standards for both local and international markets.

In his role, Allan oversees product inspection and coordinates the collection and submission of fresh produce samples for laboratory testing to ensure compliance with industry regulations and export requirements. He works closely with relevant regulatory bodies and testing facilities to verify that all products meet the necessary food safety and phytosanitary standards before shipment.

Through his commitment to quality control and regulatory compliance, Allan helps ensure that Premier Veg Mondo Ltd consistently delivers safe, high-quality fresh produce that meets the expectations of global markets.
